text.text: Two roads lead to the same blade: the forge is quick, the station is precise.
Forge: put a blade blank on the left and one to three ingots of the same material on the right. Extra ingots only add durability, ten percent each.

Station: one blade part, one handle part and one saya part, each of a different material if you like. The blade sets durability, attack and trait; the handle scales durability by tier; the saya shifts attack by tier.
Parts come from Tinkers' own stations: pour molten metal into a gold cast on the casting table, or hammer a non-castable material with the cast in the part builder.
Make a cast from gold ingots and a Tinkers' pattern in a crafting table; one cast lasts forever. The blade takes two materials, the handle and saya one each.
Both stations can be picked up; their contents spill out.
